newsitem.title: USA: U.S. PSA confirms early close Oct 11, close Oct 14.
newsitem.headline: U.S. PSA confirms early close Oct 11, close Oct 14.

text.p: The U.S. Public Securities Association (PSA) has confirmed its previously recommended early close at 1400 EDT/1800 GMT on Friday, October 11.

In addition, PSA has confirmed a full close on Monday, October 14 for trading of U.S. government securities, mortgage securities, over-the-counter investment grade corporate bonds, municipal bonds, and secondary money market trading in bankers acceptances, commercial paper and Yankee and Euro certificates of deposits.
The early close on Friday, October 11, will not affect the closing time for settlements, PSA said.
The cut-off time for pool information will remain at 1500 EDT/1900 GMT for mortgage securities, said PSA.
